name: TY - VIN - VONY
source:
The guy (Nazar) came to a small radio station in the forest. At that moment it was already night. His task is to repair some equipment, but unforgettable events await him...

[Translated from [url=https://friend-or-foe.itch.io/you-hes-they]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
青年纳扎尔来到森林里一座小型广播电台时，已是夜晚。他的任务是维修一些设备，等待他的，却是一连串难以忘怀的事件……

[译自 [url=https://friend-or-foe.itch.io/you-hes-they]Itch.io[/url]]
